question: Which range of deities is assigned to the set of eight stones in the installation?
premises: The deity series begins with Śarva.
These deities are assigned to eight stones.
inference: The deities from Śarva to Bhīma are to be installed in the eight stones.
uncertainties: The intermediate deities in the series are not listed in this verse.
plain_english: The deities from Sharva to Bhima are assigned to the eight stones.
